context.purpose: James' main reel for World Diabetes Day. Say what Jackfruit365 is, how it's used and where the claim comes from. No scare, no hype.
context.settingAndCamera: Kitchen-style set with a leaf green wall, the pack on a wooden counter, a steel tumbler and plate. Static camera, with a slow push-in on the claim card.
context.disclaimers: D3 applies as well as D1, D2 and D4, because the study is named.
watchOuts: No white coat, stethoscope or lab backdrop: James is the founder, not a doctor, and shouldn't look like one.
No result numbers on screen, and the study is cited only as the full line.
14 Nov is also Children's Day. Don't tie the reel to children.

cast.name: James
cast.description: James' avatar, founder-led. Open shirt or kurta in a calm colour, no white coat or clinical styling. Steady, friendly, unhurried delivery. Labelled as an AI avatar.

shots.visual: James at the counter, pack beside him.
shots.vo: Today is World Diabetes Day. You don't have to give up the food your family eats.

shots.visual: Cut to rice and rotis on steel plates, then back to James.
shots.vo: If someone at your table manages blood sugar, roti and rice don't have to go.

shots.visual: James holds a whole green jackfruit in one hand and the pack in the other. Cards slide in beside him.
shots.vo: So what is Jackfruit365? Green jackfruit flour, naturally high in soluble fibre.

shots.visual: Top-down. A tablespoon of flour goes into the atta. James narrates over it.
shots.vo: 100% green jackfruit, nothing else. One tablespoon per meal.

shots.visual: James back at the counter. Cut to a family table, hands passing dishes.
shots.vo: We say no change to your diet because families eat together, and nobody should have to cook two meals.

shots.visual: Study card with simple text and the journal name. Hold for 3 seconds.
shots.vo: It was tested in a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study with 40 people with type 2 diabetes, published in Nature's Nutrition & Diabetes.
shots.onScreenText: Clinically tested. Nutrition & Diabetes, 2021. · Helps control blood sugar levels*

shots.visual: James back to camera, softer tone. Disclaimer card appears.
shots.vo: It's one tablespoon of flour. Individual results may vary.

shots.visual: James at the counter, relaxed. A family table in soft focus behind him.
shots.vo: Cooking for someone at your table? Share this reel with them.
Jackfruit365 Green Jackfruit Flour. Available on Amazon.
shots.onScreenText: Pack shot. Available on Amazon. Disclaimer lines.
